0022600096.text: The Timberwolves, 1-0 and seventh in the West, make their first road trip of the season to face the 0-1 Orlando Magic, who are 10th in the East and one game back in the Southeast. Minnesota lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 132-120 loss in Orlando on April 8, 2026, and the two teams have not played each other yet this season. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Orlando is without Anthony Black (out, ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain).
